text: 据同花顺iFinD数据，2026年10月16日，ETF资金整体净流入360.79亿元，股票型净流入250.39亿元，宽基型净流入234.89亿元。当日ETF资金净流入榜单排名前3依次为：华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF（510300）净流入129.95亿元，华夏上证50ETF（510050）净流入37.72亿元，海富通中证短融ETF（511360）净流入32.28亿元。
text_en: According to Tonghuashun iFinD data, on October 16, 2026, ETF funds recorded overall net inflows of RMB 36.079 billion, with equity-type net inflows of RMB 25.039 billion and broad-based net inflows of RMB 23.489 billion. The top three ETFs by net inflow that day were: Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) with net inflows of RMB 12.995 billion, ChinaAMC SSE 50 ETF (510050) with net inflows of RMB 3.772 billion, and HFT CSI Short-Term Financing ETF (511360) with net inflows of RMB 3.228 billion.
